name: Cultural Recreation Advisory Board Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  CULTURAL RECREATION ADVISORY BOARD
  Westlake Village City Hall
  Large Community Meeting Room
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village

  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 4, 2025, at 6:00 p.m.

Written Public Comments on agenda items may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at
cityclerk@wlv.org no later than 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be
provided to the Cultural Recreation Advisory Board.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Committee Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are
available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal business hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
Committee-Supplemental-Packets

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less
 than 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal
 business hours and are posted on the City’s Website -https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
 Committee-Supplemental-Packets

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your
 notifications.  Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or
 https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:00 pm

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Pro Tem McSweeney, Councilmember Pearl

  Members of the Cultural Recreation Advisory Board:

  Amy Brink, Suzanne Corwin, Laura Dawson, Peggy Frank, Elisa
  Hirsch, Christian Ipsen, Michael Lang, Andrea Robinson, Marcus
  Shapiro, Daniel Torres, Christianne Winthrop

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may offer comment only in person at this meeting.

BUSINESS:

1.  Staff Updates
  a. Recruitment and openings
2.  Summer Recap
  a. Concerts
  b. 4th of July
3.  City Celebration
  a. Planning
  b. Volunteering

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, August 28, 2025 at 11:00 a.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  August 28, 2025
